svg.aria-label: Flipbook — scans a match’s trickplay thumbnails on the TV and marks each score change on the seek bar. Six grease-pencil ticks land on the seek bar; the app has never seen a feed, a schedule, or decoded video.

text.tspan: read on the TV from its trickplay thumbnails.

svg.text: NO EVENT FEED · NO VIDEO DECODE
